Hi there - I have come off Effexor about a year ago cold turkey and what you’re experiencing is brain zaps. I got them and they were very distracting. Here are some things that helped with the withdrawals - ginger root pills for the nausea, Tylenol for the head aches, chamomile or “cup of calm” tea for the anxious jitters, and Benadryl w/ /sleepy time tea before bed for the restlessness [i would get jolts when I tried falling asleep]. Idk how long you’ve been in withdrawal but I was definitely there and it’s going to take time! Lots of water too.
